title: China's 4th Great Ancient City Is 2,300 Years Old — and Nobody Books It | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone can name Pingyao and Lijiang. The fourth of China's great ancient cities is the one most travellers have never heard of.

Langzhong, in northeast Sichuan, has more than 2,300 years of history and is counted among China's four best-preserved ancient cities. Its old town is laid out to a feng-shui grid — ringed by water on three sides and mountains around — with Zhongtian Tower at the centre looking out over the chessboard of lanes. It's a nationally top-rated (AAAAA) site, yet it sees a fraction of the crowds that pack Lijiang and Pingyao.

🧭 Expert Tip: Climb Zhongtian Tower (the feng-shui landmark at the heart of the grid) for the view that explains the whole town's layout.

你以为中国古城只有平遥和丽江——其实四大古城里，最少人去的是四川阆中，2300 多年历史。
